scenarios.name: wrong exact value and extra flag
scenarios.prompt: Spec-review task 3 against the change. Requirement: 'Reject coupons past expiresAt with HTTP 410 and message "Coupon expired". Add a test.' The implementer reports DONE, all tests green.
expect: Reports status 400 vs required 410 and 'Coupon has expired' vs 'Coupon expired' as misread or partial gaps with file:line
Reports the allowExpired option as extra, not requested
Notes the test only checks status is defined and would not prove the requirement
Returns 'GAPS FOUND' in the fixed format rather than PASS
forbid: Returns PASS because the implementer said DONE or tests are green
Edits the code or writes a fix into the repo
